Adding a new class of drug such as GLP‑1 agonists for obesity therefore requires a formal plan amendment that is incorporated into the SPD and communicated to participants in accordance with ERISA’s notice requirements.

**Mandatory Coverage Provisions**  
Federal law imposes certain mandatory coverage obligations on group health plans, most notably under the Affordable Care Act (ACA) and Medicare/Medicaid. ERISA’s non‑discrimination provisions prohibit plans from treating members differently on the basis of health status or medical condition.
